source.text: לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ לְדָוִ֗ד מִזְמ֥וֹר שִֽׁיר׃

records.literal_gloss: For the director. Of David. A psalm. A song.

en.L: For the director: of David; a psalm; a song.
en.B: For the music director. Of David. A psalm. A song.
en.R: For the leader of the music. A song of David.

fr.L: Au chef de chœur : de David ; un psaume ; un cantique.
fr.B: Au chef de chœur. De David. Un psaume. Un cantique.
fr.R: Pour le chef des musiciens. Un chant de David.

sw.L: Kwa kiongozi wa kwaya: ya Daudi; zaburi; wimbo.
sw.B: Kwa kiongozi wa kwaya. Ya Daudi. Zaburi. Wimbo.
sw.R: Kwa kiongozi wa waimbaji. Wimbo wa Daudi.

es.L: Al director del coro: de David; un salmo; un cántico.
es.B: Al director del coro. De David. Un salmo. Un cántico.
es.R: Para el director de la música. Un canto de David.

decisions.choice: The title is verse 1
decisions.reason: The title is part of the Hebrew text and is counted as verse 1, so the verse numbers here are one higher than in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: the director: the one who leads the music
decisions.reason: As in 4:1, probably the leader of the temple music.

decisions.choice: a hard and ancient song
decisions.reason: Psalm 68 has more rare words than almost any other psalm, and many lines are hard to read with certainty. It seems to follow God's march from Sinai through the wilderness to his dwelling on Zion, and on to the homage of the nations. Its language is close to the old songs of Exodus 15, Deuteronomy 33 and Judges 5.

decisions.choice: A song of David
decisions.reason: Readable gives one plain word for the two words for a song.

source.text: יָק֣וּם אֱ֭לֹהִים יָפ֣וּצוּ אוֹיְבָ֑יו וְיָנ֥וּסוּ מְ֝שַׂנְאָ֗יו מִפָּנָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: Let God arise; let his enemies be scattered, and let those who hate him flee from before him.

en.L: Let God arise; let {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} enemies be scattered, \q and let those who hate {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} flee from before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: Let God rise up and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} enemies scatter; \q let all who hate {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} run from {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} presence.
en.R: Let God get up! Let {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} enemies run off in every direction. \q Let those who hate {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} run away from {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

fr.L: Que Dieu se lève ; que {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} ennemis soient dispersés, \q et que ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} haïssent fuient devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.
fr.B: Que Dieu se lève et que {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} ennemis se dispersent ; \q que tous ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} haïssent s’enfuient loin de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} présence.
fr.R: Que Dieu se lève ! Que {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} ennemis s’enfuient de tous côtés. \q Que ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} détestent s’enfuient loin de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.

sw.L: Mungu na ainuke; adui {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} na watawanyike, \q na wale wanaomchukia {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} wakimbie mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.B: Mungu na asimame, na adui {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} watawanyike; \q wote wanaomchukia na wakimbie mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.R: Mungu na aamke! Adui {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} na wakimbie kila upande. \q Wale wanaomchukia na wamkimbie {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}.

es.L: Levántese Dios; sean dispersados {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} enemigos, \q y huyan de delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} los que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} aborrecen.
es.B: Que Dios se levante y {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} enemigos se dispersen; \q que todos los que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} odian huyan de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} presencia.
es.R: ¡Que Dios se levante! Que {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} enemigos salgan corriendo en todas direcciones. \q Que los que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} odian huyan de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.

decisions.choice: the song of the ark
decisions.reason: The line echoes the words Moses said whenever the ark set out: "Arise, LORD, and let your enemies be scattered, and let those who hate you flee before you" (Numbers 10:35). The psalm opens as a march of God at the head of his people. Here the verbs speak of God ("let God arise") and the text says "God" where Numbers has the name.

decisions.choice: let God arise: a wish or a statement
alternatives: God will arise, his enemies will be scattered
decisions.reason: The verbs can be read as wishes or as confident statements of what will happen. Verse 4 is clearly a wish, so the opening is read the same way.

decisions.choice: rise up (B); get up (R)
decisions.reason: As in the call "Arise, LORD" elsewhere in the Psalms (3:8; 7:7).

source.text: כְּהִנְדֹּ֥ף עָשָׁ֗ן תִּ֫נְדֹּ֥ף כְּהִמֵּ֣ס דּ֭וֹנַג מִפְּנֵי־אֵ֑שׁ יֹאבְד֥וּ רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים מִפְּנֵ֥י אֱלֹהִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: As smoke is driven, you drive [them]; as wax melts from before fire, let [the] wicked perish from before God.

en.L: As smoke is driven away, [so] {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} drive [them] away; \q as wax melts before fire, \q let [the] wicked perish before God.
en.B: Blow them away as smoke is blown away; \q as wax melts in front of the flames, \q may the wicked come to nothing in God's presence.
en.R: Blow them away like smoke! \q Let evil people melt away before God like wax near a fire.

fr.L: Comme la fumée est chassée, [ainsi] {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} [les] chasses ; \q comme la cire fond devant le feu, \q que [les] méchants périssent devant Dieu.
fr.B: Disperse-les comme on disperse la fumée ; \q comme la cire fond devant la flamme, \q que les méchants s’anéantissent devant Dieu.
fr.R: Chasse-les comme de la fumée ! \q Que les méchants fondent devant Dieu comme de la cire près du feu.

sw.L: Kama moshi unavyopeperushwa, [ndivyo] {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unavyowapeperusha; \q kama nta inavyoyeyuka mbele ya moto, \q waovu na waangamie mbele za Mungu.
sw.B: Uwapeperushe kama moshi unavyopeperushwa; \q kama nta inavyoyeyuka mbele ya miali ya moto, \q waovu na watoweke mbele za Mungu.
sw.R: Uwapeperushe mbali kama moshi! \q Watu waovu na wayeyuke mbele za Mungu kama nta karibu na moto.

es.L: Como se disipa el humo, [así] {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} [los] disipas; \q como la cera se derrite ante el fuego, \q perezcan [los] malvados delante de Dios.
es.B: Dispérsalos como se dispersa el humo; \q como la cera se derrite frente a las llamas, \q que los malvados se desvanezcan en la presencia de Dios.
es.R: ¡Llévatelos como el viento se lleva el humo! \q Que los malvados se derritan delante de Dios como cera junto al fuego.

decisions.choice: you drive them: a word to God
decisions.reason: For a moment the psalm speaks to God directly ("you drive them away") before speaking of him again. The verb is the same as "driven": smoke driven by the wind.

decisions.choice: smoke and wax: what does not last
decisions.reason: Smoke scatters in the wind and wax runs in the heat (37:20; 97:5; Micah 1:4). God's enemies cannot stand before him.

decisions.choice: Blow them away
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable make the line a prayer to God, which is its force.

source.text: וְֽצַדִּיקִ֗ים יִשְׂמְח֣וּ יַֽ֭עַלְצוּ לִפְנֵ֥י אֱלֹהִ֗ים וְיָשִׂ֥ישׂוּ בְשִׂמְחָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] righteous, let them rejoice; let them exult before God and let them be glad with gladness.

en.L: But the righteous — let them rejoice; \q let them exult before God and be glad with gladness.
en.B: But let the righteous be glad and celebrate before God; \q let them be overjoyed.
en.R: But let people who do what is right be happy. \q Let them celebrate in front of God and be full of joy.

fr.L: Mais les justes — qu’ils se réjouissent ; \q qu’ils exultent devant Dieu et soient dans l’allégresse avec joie.
fr.B: Mais que les justes se réjouissent et fassent la fête devant Dieu ; \q qu’ils débordent de joie.
fr.R: Mais que ceux qui font ce qui est juste soient heureux. \q Qu’ils fassent la fête devant Dieu et soient pleins de joie.

sw.L: Lakini wenye haki — na wafurahi; \q na washangilie mbele za Mungu na kufurahi kwa furaha.
sw.B: Lakini wenye haki na wafurahi na kusherehekea mbele za Mungu; \q na wajae shangwe.
sw.R: Lakini watu wanaotenda yaliyo haki na wafurahi. \q Na washerehekee mbele za Mungu na kujaa furaha.

es.L: Pero los justos, que se alegren; \q que se regocijen delante de Dios y se gocen con alegría.
es.B: Pero que los justos se alegren y hagan fiesta delante de Dios; \q que estén llenos de gozo.
es.R: Pero que los que hacen lo que es justo estén felices. \q Que celebren delante de Dios y se llenen de alegría.

decisions.choice: but: the righteous set against the wicked
decisions.reason: The wicked perish before God (verse 3); the righteous rejoice before him.

decisions.choice: be glad with gladness: great joy
decisions.reason: A verb with its own noun stresses the action: they are full of joy.

decisions.choice: people who do what is right
decisions.reason: As elsewhere in the Psalms, Readable says who the righteous are.

source.text: שִׁ֤ירוּ׀לֵֽאלֹהִים֮ זַמְּר֪וּ שְׁ֫מ֥וֹ סֹ֡לּוּ לָרֹכֵ֣ב בָּ֭עֲרָבוֹת בְּיָ֥הּ שְׁמ֗וֹ וְעִלְז֥וּ לְפָנָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: Sing to God, sing praise [to] his name; build up [a way] for the one riding through the deserts — in Yah [is] his name — and exult before him.

en.L: Sing to God, sing praise [to] {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name; \q build up [a road] for the one who rides through the deserts — \q {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}} [is] {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name — and exult before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: Sing to God, make music to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name; \q prepare a highway for the one who rides through the deserts. \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yah}} is {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name; celebrate before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}!
en.R: Sing to God! Make music to honor {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name! \q Build a road for the one who rides across the desert. \q His name is {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}. Be happy in front of {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}!

fr.L: Chantez à Dieu, chantez {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom ; \q frayez [une route] à celui qui chevauche à travers les déserts — \q {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} [est] {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom — et exultez devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.
fr.B: Chantez à Dieu, jouez en l’honneur de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom ; \q préparez une route pour celui qui chevauche à travers les déserts. \q {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} est {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom ; soyez en fête devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} !
fr.R: Chantez à Dieu ! Jouez de la musique pour honorer {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom ! \q Construisez une route pour celui qui traverse le désert. \q Son nom est {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}}. Soyez heureux devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} !

sw.L: Mwimbieni Mungu, imbeni sifa [kwa] jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}; \q mtengenezeeni [njia] yule apandaye katika majangwa — \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}} [ndilo] jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} — na mshangilie mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.B: Mwimbieni Mungu, lipigieni jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} muziki; \q mtayarishieni njia kuu yule apitaye majangwani. \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}} ndilo jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}; shangilieni mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}!
sw.R: Mwimbieni Mungu! Pigeni muziki kuliheshimu jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}! \q Jengeni barabara kwa ajili ya yule apitaye jangwani. \q Jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}. Furahini mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}!

es.L: {{plural_you:Canten|Cantad}} a Dios, {{plural_you:canten|cantad}} alabanzas [a] {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre; \q {{plural_you:preparen|preparad}} [camino] al que cabalga por los desiertos \q —{{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yah}} [es] {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre— y {{plural_you:regocíjense|regocijaos}} delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.
es.B: {{plural_you:Canten|Cantad}} a Dios, {{plural_you:hagan|haced}} música a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre; \q {{plural_you:preparen|preparad}} una calzada al que cabalga por los desiertos. \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yah}} es {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre; ¡{{plural_you:alégrense|alegraos}} delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}!
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Canten|Cantad}} a Dios! ¡{{plural_you:Hagan|Haced}} música en honor de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre! \q {{plural_you:Construyan|Construid}} un camino para el que cabalga por el desierto. \q Su nombre es {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yah}}. ¡{{plural_you:Alégrense|Alegraos}} delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}!

decisions.choice: the deserts: the dry lands of the wilderness
alternatives: the clouds: lift up a song to the one who rides on the clouds
decisions.reason: The word ('aravot) usually means the dry plains or wilderness, and verse 8 has God marching through the wilderness. Many read it here as "clouds", because verse 34 has God "riding in the heavens" and an old title of a Canaanite storm god was "rider of the clouds"; the psalm would then claim that title for Israel's God.

decisions.choice: build up: raise a road
decisions.reason: The verb (salal) means to heap up earth for a road, as in Isaiah 62:10 and the call to prepare a highway in the desert (Isaiah 40:3). Some take it as "lift up" a song.

decisions.choice: Yah: the short form of the divine name
decisions.reason: Yah is a shortened form of the name YHWH (as in Exodus 15:2 and in "Hallelu-yah"). It is rendered like the full name, with Yah as the alternative.

decisions.choice: in Yah is his name: his name is Yah
decisions.reason: The small word "in" here marks what something is: his name is Yah.

decisions.choice: "le SEIGNEUR" for the short name Yah, with "Yah" as the reader's alternative
decisions.reason: Yah is the short form of the divine name. French writes it like the full name, "le SEIGNEUR", and the alternative shows the short form itself, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "BWANA" for Yah by default, with "Yah" as the setting alternative
alternatives: "Yahwe" as the alternative, as for the full name
decisions.reason: Yah is the short form of the divine name. Swahili shows it as "BWANA" in capitals like the full name, and a reader who switches the setting sees the short form itself, as in the English.

decisions.choice: el SEÑOR, with Yah as the divine_name alternative
decisions.reason: Yah is the short form of God's name. It takes the same default as the full name, "el SEÑOR" in capitals, and the reader's alternative is "Yah", as the terms for these books settle.

source.text: אֲבִ֣י יְ֭תוֹמִים וְדַיַּ֣ן אַלְמָנ֑וֹת אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים בִּמְע֥וֹן קָדְשֽׁוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: A father of [the] fatherless and a judge of widows [is] God in [the] dwelling of his holiness.

en.L: A father of the fatherless and a judge of widows \q [is] God in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy dwelling.
en.B: From {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy dwelling \q God acts as father to orphans and defender of widows.
en.R: God lives in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy home. \q He is a father to children who have no father. He stands up for widows.

fr.L: Père des orphelins et juge des veuves, \q [tel est] Dieu dans {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} sainte demeure.
fr.B: Depuis {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} sainte demeure, \q Dieu se fait le père des orphelins et le défenseur des veuves.
fr.R: Dieu habite dans {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} sainte maison. \q Il est un père pour les enfants qui n’ont pas de père. Il prend la défense des veuves.

sw.L: Baba wa yatima na mtetezi wa wajane \q [ni] Mungu katika makao {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} matakatifu.
sw.B: Kutoka makao {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} matakatifu \q Mungu ni baba kwa yatima na mtetezi wa wajane.
sw.R: Mungu anaishi katika makao {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} matakatifu. \q Yeye ni baba kwa watoto wasio na baba. Anawatetea wajane.

es.L: Padre de los huérfanos y defensor de las viudas \q [es] Dios en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} santa morada.
es.B: Desde {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} santa morada \q Dios es padre de los huérfanos y defensor de las viudas.
es.R: Dios vive en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} santa casa. \q Es un padre para los niños que no tienen padre. Defiende a las viudas.

decisions.choice: judge: one who takes up their case
decisions.reason: A judge (dayyan) here is one who defends the rights of the weak in court. Widows and the fatherless had no one to speak for them (Deuteronomy 10:18).

decisions.choice: the holy God cares for the helpless
decisions.reason: The God who lives in holiness, far above, is the one who looks after those with no protector.

decisions.choice: God first in the sentence
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name God early for a clear sentence; the Hebrew holds the name back to the end.

source.text: אֱלֹהִ֤ים׀מ֘וֹשִׁ֤יב יְחִידִ֨ים׀בַּ֗יְתָה מוֹצִ֣יא אֲ֭סִירִים בַּכּוֹשָׁר֑וֹת אַ֥ךְ ס֝וֹרֲרִ֗ים שָׁכְנ֥וּ צְחִיחָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: God [is] making [the] solitary dwell [in a] house; bringing out prisoners into prosperity; only [the] rebellious dwell [in] a scorched land.

en.L: God makes the solitary dwell in a home; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} brings out prisoners into prosperity; \q only the rebellious dwell [in] a scorched land.
en.B: God gives the lonely a home to live in; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} leads prisoners out into well-being, \q but rebels stay in a sunbaked land.
en.R: God gives lonely people a family and a home. \q He sets prisoners free and makes them prosper. \q But people who rebel against {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} have to live in a dry, empty land.

fr.L: Dieu fait habiter les solitaires dans une maison ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fait sortir les captifs vers la prospérité ; \q seuls les rebelles habitent [une terre] brûlée.
fr.B: Dieu donne une maison où vivre à ceux qui sont seuls ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} conduit les prisonniers vers le bonheur, \q mais les rebelles restent sur une terre desséchée.
fr.R: Dieu donne aux gens seuls une famille et une maison. \q Il libère les prisonniers et les fait prospérer. \q Mais ceux qui se révoltent contre {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} doivent vivre dans un pays sec et vide.

sw.L: Mungu anawakalisha wapweke katika nyumba; \q {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} anawatoa wafungwa na kuwaleta kwenye kufanikiwa; \q waasi tu ndio wanaokaa [katika] nchi iliyokauka.
sw.B: Mungu huwapa wapweke nyumba ya kuishi; \q {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} huwaongoza wafungwa kutoka gerezani kwenye hali njema, \q lakini waasi hubaki katika nchi iliyochomwa na jua.
sw.R: Mungu huwapa watu wapweke jamaa na nyumba. \q Huwaweka wafungwa huru na kuwafanikisha. \q Lakini watu wanaomwasi {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} hulazimika kuishi katika nchi kavu na tupu.

es.L: Dios hace habitar en un hogar a los solitarios; \q {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} saca a los cautivos a prosperidad; \q solo los rebeldes habitan [en] tierra calcinada.
es.B: Dios da a los solitarios un hogar donde vivir; \q {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} saca a los presos al bienestar, \q pero los rebeldes se quedan en una tierra quemada por el sol.
es.R: Dios les da a los que están solos una familia y un hogar. \q Pone en libertad a los presos y hace que les vaya bien. \q Pero los que se rebelan contra {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} tienen que vivir en una tierra seca y vacía.

decisions.choice: prosperity: a good and happy state
decisions.reason: The word (kosharot) is found only here. It seems related to a verb meaning "to succeed". Some connect it with a word for songs, "with singing".

decisions.choice: a house: a home, a family
decisions.reason: The word (bayit) means both a house and a household. People who are alone are given a place and a family to belong to.

decisions.choice: from slavery to the land
decisions.reason: The God who brought Israel out of Egypt ("brought out" is the Exodus verb) frees the captive; the rebels of the wilderness died in the desert (Numbers 14:29-35).

decisions.choice: against him
decisions.reason: Readable says whom they rebel against.

source.text: אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים בְּ֭צֵאתְךָ לִפְנֵ֣י עַמֶּ֑ךָ בְּצַעְדְּךָ֖ בִֽישִׁימ֣וֹן סֶֽלָה׃

records.literal_gloss: God, when you went out before your people, when you marched through [the] wasteland, Selah.

en.L: God, when {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} went out before {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people, \q when {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} marched through the wasteland, Selah
en.B: God, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} went out at the head of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people; \q {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} strode through the desert. Selah
en.R: God, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} went out in front of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people. \q You marched with them through the desert. Selah

fr.L: Dieu, quand {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} sortis devant {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple, \q quand {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}avanças à travers le désert, Sélah
fr.B: Dieu, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es sorti à la tête de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple ; \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as marché à travers le désert. Sélah
fr.R: Dieu, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es sorti devant {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple. \q Tu as marché avec eux à travers le désert. Sélah

sw.L: Ee Mungu, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ulipotoka mbele ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, \q {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ulipopita katika nyika, Sela
sw.B: Ee Mungu, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ulitoka ukiwatangulia watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}; \q {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ulitembea kwa hatua kuu katika jangwa. Sela
sw.R: Ee Mungu, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ulitoka mbele ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}. \q Ulitembea pamoja nao katika jangwa. Sela

es.L: Oh Dios, cuando {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} saliste delante de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo, \q cuando marchaste por el desierto, Selah
es.B: Dios, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} saliste a la cabeza de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo; \q {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} avanzaste por el desierto. Selah
es.R: Dios, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} saliste delante de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo. \q Marchaste con ellos por el desierto. Selah

decisions.choice: the march through the wilderness
decisions.reason: Verses 8-9 are very close to the Song of Deborah: "LORD, when you went out from Seir, when you marched from the field of Edom, the earth shook, and the heavens dropped" (Judges 5:4-5). God led Israel from Egypt through the wilderness in the pillar of cloud and fire (Exodus 13:21).

decisions.choice: God in place of the name
decisions.reason: Judges 5:4 has the name, the LORD; this psalm says "God". Psalms 42-83 mostly say "God" ('elohim) where other psalms use the name. The word in the text is rendered.

decisions.choice: a sentence that runs on
decisions.reason: The "when" clauses run on into verse 9, so Literal ends with a comma before the Selah. Balanced and Readable make this verse a sentence of its own.

decisions.choice: you went out ... you strode
alternatives: when you went out ... when you marched
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable state the march as a fact, since Selah breaks the sentence.

decisions.choice: Selah: a word whose meaning is no longer known
alternatives: lift up (the voice or the music)
decisions.reason: Selah stands at the end of a line 71 times in the Psalms and 3 times in Habakkuk 3. It is probably a direction for singing or music, perhaps a pause or an interlude; the ancient Greek translation renders it with a word meaning "interlude". It is not part of what is said, and here it marks a break after the line.

decisions.choice: Selah, kept as it is
decisions.reason: Its meaning is unknown (see the meaning decision on Selah), so every level keeps the word rather than guess, and keeps it apart from the sentence.

decisions.choice: the passé simple at Literal in verses 8-9 only, the passé composé at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew's "when" clause, so verses 8-9 read as one sentence of narrative and French uses its narrative tense there. Balanced and Readable state the march as a fact, as the English does, in the passé composé of the rest of the psalm.

decisions.choice: "Sela" at the end of the verse, here in the middle of a sentence at Literal
alternatives: moving it to the end of verse 9
decisions.reason: The Hebrew puts Selah at the end of verse 8, though the sentence goes on; Swahili keeps it where the English keeps it.

source.text: אֶ֤רֶץ רָעָ֨שָׁה׀אַף־שָׁמַ֣יִם נָטְפוּ֮ מִפְּנֵ֪י אֱלֹ֫הִ֥ים זֶ֥ה סִינַ֑י מִפְּנֵ֥י אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: [the] earth quaked; even [the] heavens dropped before God, this Sinai, before God, [the] God of Israel.

en.L: the earth quaked; even the heavens dropped [rain] before God, \q the One of Sinai, \q before God, the God of Israel.
en.B: The earth trembled and the sky streamed with rain before God, \q the God of Sinai; \q before God, Israel's God.
en.R: The earth shook and rain poured down from the sky when God came, \q the God of Mount Sinai, \q the God of Israel.

fr.L: la terre trembla ; même les cieux ruisselèrent devant Dieu, \q celui du Sinaï, \q devant Dieu, le Dieu d’Israël.
fr.B: La terre a tremblé et le ciel a versé la pluie devant Dieu, \q le Dieu du Sinaï ; \q devant Dieu, le Dieu d’Israël.
fr.R: La terre a tremblé et la pluie est tombée du ciel quand Dieu est venu, \q le Dieu du mont Sinaï, \q le Dieu d’Israël.

sw.L: dunia ilitetemeka; hata mbingu zilidondosha [mvua] mbele za Mungu, \q Yule wa Sinai, \q mbele za Mungu, Mungu wa Israeli.
sw.B: Dunia ilitetemeka na anga likamwaga mvua mbele za Mungu, \q Mungu wa Sinai; \q mbele za Mungu, Mungu wa Israeli.
sw.R: Dunia ilitikisika na mvua ikanyesha kutoka angani Mungu alipokuja, \q Mungu wa Mlima Sinai, \q Mungu wa Israeli.

es.L: la tierra tembló; también los cielos destilaron [lluvia] delante de Dios, \q el del Sinaí, \q delante de Dios, el Dios de Israel.
es.B: La tierra tembló y el cielo derramó lluvia delante de Dios, \q el Dios del Sinaí; \q delante de Dios, el Dios de Israel.
es.R: La tierra se sacudió y la lluvia cayó a cántaros del cielo cuando Dios vino, \q el Dios del monte Sinaí, \q el Dios de Israel.

decisions.choice: this Sinai: the One of Sinai
decisions.reason: The words "this Sinai" are an old title, "the One of Sinai", as in Judges 5:5: the God who appeared on Mount Sinai. Some read "even Sinai itself (shook)".

decisions.choice: Sinai
decisions.reason: When God came down on Sinai the mountain shook and smoked (Exodus 19:16-18).

decisions.choice: dropped: poured down rain
decisions.reason: The verb (nataf) is to drip or pour; the next verse speaks of rain.

decisions.choice: rain
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says only "dropped"; the next verse shows that rain is meant.

source.text: גֶּ֣שֶׁם נְ֭דָבוֹת תָּנִ֣יף אֱלֹהִ֑ים נַחֲלָתְךָ֥ וְ֝נִלְאָ֗ה אַתָּ֥ה כֽוֹנַנְתָּֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Rain of free gifts you shed abroad, God; your inheritance, and it was weary, you made it firm.

en.L: A rain of free gifts {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} poured out, God; \q {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} inheritance, when it was weary, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} made it firm.
en.B: God, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} sent showers of generous rain; \q when {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} land was worn out, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} restored it.
en.R: God, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} sent plenty of rain. \q Your land was dry and tired, but {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} made it strong again.

fr.L: Une pluie de dons généreux {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as répandue, Dieu ; \q {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} héritage, quand il était épuisé, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} l’as affermi.
fr.B: Dieu, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as envoyé des averses généreuses ; \q quand {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} pays était épuisé, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} l’as relevé.
fr.R: Dieu, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as envoyé beaucoup de pluie. \q Ton pays était sec et fatigué, mais {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} l’as rendu fort de nouveau.

sw.L: Mvua ya vipawa vya bure {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} uliimwaga, Ee Mungu; \q urithi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, ulipochoka, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} uliuimarisha.
sw.B: Ee Mungu, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ulituma manyunyu ya mvua tele; \q nchi {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} ilipochoka, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} uliirejesha.
sw.R: Ee Mungu, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ulituma mvua nyingi. \q Nchi {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} ilikuwa kavu na imechoka, lakini {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} uliifanya imara tena.

es.L: Lluvia de dones generosos derramaste, oh Dios; \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} heredad, cuando estaba exhausta, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} la afirmaste.
es.B: Dios, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} enviaste lluvias generosas; \q cuando {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} tierra estaba agotada, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} la restauraste.
es.R: Dios, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} enviaste mucha lluvia. \q Tu tierra estaba seca y cansada, pero {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} la hiciste fuerte otra vez.

decisions.choice: free gifts: generous, given freely
decisions.reason: The word (nedavot) is used for freewill offerings; here it is rain given freely and in plenty.

decisions.choice: your inheritance: your land, or your people
decisions.reason: God's inheritance (nachalah) is the land he gave Israel, and also Israel itself. The rain on a weary land fits the land best.

decisions.choice: your land
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the inheritance is here (m2).

source.text: חַיָּתְךָ֥ יָֽשְׁבוּ־בָ֑הּ תָּ֤כִ֥ין בְּטוֹבָתְךָ֖ לֶעָנִ֣י אֱלֹהִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: Your living [band], they dwelt in it; you prepared in your goodness for the poor, God.

en.L: Your band dwelt in it; \q {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} provided in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} goodness for the poor, God.
en.B: Your flock found a home there; \q out of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} goodness, God, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} made ready what the afflicted needed.
en.R: Your people came to live there. \q God, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are good, and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} gave poor people what they needed.

fr.L: Ta troupe y a habité ; \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as préparé dans {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bonté pour le pauvre, Dieu.
fr.B: Ton troupeau y a trouvé une demeure ; \q dans {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bonté, Dieu, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as préparé ce dont le malheureux avait besoin.
fr.R: Ton peuple est venu y vivre. \q Dieu, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es bon, et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as donné aux pauvres ce dont ils avaient besoin.

sw.L: Kundi {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} lilikaa ndani yake; \q {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} uliwaandalia maskini kwa wema {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, Ee Mungu.
sw.B: Kundi {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} lilipata makao huko; \q kwa wema {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, Ee Mungu, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} uliwaandalia wanyonge mahitaji yao.
sw.R: Watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} walikuja kuishi huko. \q Ee Mungu, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ni mwema, na {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} uliwapa maskini walichohitaji.

es.L: Tu grey habitó en ella; \q {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} proveíste en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} bondad para el pobre, oh Dios.
es.B: Tu rebaño halló allí un hogar; \q por {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} bondad, oh Dios, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} preparaste lo que necesitaba el afligido.
es.R: Tu pueblo se fue a vivir allí. \q Dios, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres bueno, y les diste a los pobres lo que necesitaban.

decisions.choice: your living band: your people, your flock
decisions.reason: The word (chayyah) usually means a living creature or animal; here it seems to mean a group or company (as in 2 Samuel 23:13), God's people pictured as his flock.

decisions.choice: the poor: the afflicted, humble people
decisions.reason: The word ('ani) means poor or afflicted. Here it is Israel itself, a weak people that God provided for in the land.

decisions.choice: in it: in the land
decisions.reason: "It" is the inheritance of verse 10, the land.

source.text: אֲדֹנָ֥י יִתֶּן־אֹ֑מֶר הַֽ֝מְבַשְּׂר֗וֹת צָבָ֥א רָֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] Lord gives [the] word; the women who bear the news [are] a great host:

en.L: The Lord gives the word; \q the women who bring the news [are] a great host:
en.B: The Lord speaks the word, \q and a great army of women spreads the good news:
en.R: The Lord gives the command. \q Then a huge crowd of women spreads the good news:

fr.L: Le Seigneur donne la parole ; \q les messagères [sont] une grande armée :
fr.B: Le Seigneur prononce la parole, \q et une grande armée de femmes répand la bonne nouvelle :
fr.R: Le Seigneur donne l’ordre. \q Alors une foule immense de femmes répand la bonne nouvelle :

sw.L: Bwana anatoa neno; \q wanawake wanaoleta habari [ni] jeshi kubwa:
sw.B: Bwana anasema neno, \q na jeshi kubwa la wanawake linatangaza habari njema:
sw.R: Bwana anatoa amri. \q Kisha umati mkubwa wa wanawake unaeneza habari njema:

es.L: El Señor da la palabra; \q las mujeres que anuncian la noticia [son] una gran multitud:
es.B: El Señor pronuncia la palabra, \q y un gran ejército de mujeres difunde la buena noticia:
es.R: El Señor da la orden. \q Entonces una gran multitud de mujeres difunde la buena noticia:

decisions.choice: women who bring the news: women singing the victory
decisions.reason: The word for those who bring good news is feminine, as in Isaiah 40:9. In Israel women met the returning army with songs of victory (Exodus 15:20-21; Judges 5; 1 Samuel 18).

decisions.choice: the word: God's command, or the news of victory
decisions.reason: The word ('omer) is a spoken word. The Lord speaks, perhaps the command for battle or the word of victory, and the women spread it.

decisions.choice: what the women say
decisions.reason: The verse ends with a colon: the next verse gives the news they spread.

source.text: מַלְכֵ֣י צְ֭בָאוֹת יִדֹּד֣וּן יִדֹּד֑וּן וּנְוַת בַּ֝֗יִת תְּחַלֵּ֥ק שָׁלָֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: Kings of armies flee, they flee, and [the] beautiful one of [the] house divides plunder.

en.L: "Kings of armies flee, they flee, \q and she who stays at home divides [the] plunder."
en.B: "Kings with their armies run, they run away, \q and the woman who stayed at home shares out the spoil."
en.R: "Kings and their armies run away as fast as they can! \q The women at home divide up what was taken from them."

fr.L: « Les rois des armées fuient, ils fuient, \q et celle qui reste à la maison partage [le] butin. »
fr.B: « Les rois et leurs armées s’enfuient, ils s’enfuient, \q et celle qui est restée à la maison partage le butin. »
fr.R: « Les rois et leurs armées s’enfuient à toute vitesse ! \q Les femmes restées à la maison partagent ce qu’on leur a pris. »

sw.L: "Wafalme wa majeshi wanakimbia, wanakimbia, \q na yeye akaaye nyumbani anagawa nyara."
sw.B: "Wafalme pamoja na majeshi yao wanakimbia, wanakimbia mbali, \q na mwanamke aliyebaki nyumbani anagawa nyara."
sw.R: "Wafalme na majeshi yao wanakimbia kwa kasi kadiri wawezavyo! \q Wanawake walio nyumbani wanagawana vitu vilivyotekwa kutoka kwao."

es.L: «Reyes de ejércitos huyen, huyen, \q y la que se queda en casa reparte [el] botín».
es.B: «Los reyes con sus ejércitos corren, salen huyendo, \q y la mujer que se quedó en casa reparte el botín».
es.R: «¡Los reyes y sus ejércitos huyen tan rápido como pueden! \q Las mujeres en casa se reparten lo que les quitaron».

decisions.choice: the women's song
decisions.reason: This verse is taken as the news the women of verse 12 spread. It is not certain where their words end; the hard verse 14 is left outside the quotation.

decisions.choice: the beautiful one of the house: the woman at home
decisions.reason: The word (newat) can mean "beautiful one" or "one who dwells". Either way it is the woman who stayed at home and now shares the spoil, as in Judges 5:30.

decisions.choice: flee, they flee: run headlong
decisions.reason: The repeated verb shows the haste of their flight.

decisions.choice: the women
decisions.reason: Readable makes the figure plural, since she stands for all the women at home.

source.text: אִֽם־תִּשְׁכְּבוּן֮ בֵּ֪ין שְׁפַ֫תָּ֥יִם כַּנְפֵ֣י י֭וֹנָה נֶחְפָּ֣ה בַכֶּ֑סֶף וְ֝אֶבְרוֹתֶ֗יהָ בִּֽירַקְרַ֥ק חָרֽוּץ׃

records.literal_gloss: If you lie down between [the] saddlebags, [the] wings of a dove [are] covered with silver and its pinions with greenish gold.

en.L: If you lie down between the sheepfolds — \q the wings of a dove covered with silver, \q and its pinions with shimmering gold.
en.B: Even if you men lie among the sheep pens, \q there are a dove's wings sheathed in silver, \q its feathers shining with pale gold.
en.R: Even if some of you stayed home by the sheep pens, \q there is treasure for you: \q a dove with wings covered in silver and feathers shining with gold.

fr.L: Si vous vous couchez entre les enclos — \q les ailes d’une colombe couvertes d’argent, \q et ses plumes d’un or chatoyant.
fr.B: Même si vous, les hommes, restez couchés parmi les enclos, \q voici les ailes d’une colombe revêtues d’argent, \q ses plumes brillant d’un or pâle.
fr.R: Même si certains d’entre vous sont restés près des enclos à moutons, \q il y a un trésor pour vous : \q une colombe aux ailes couvertes d’argent et aux plumes brillantes d’or.

sw.L: Ingawa mnalala kati ya mazizi — \q mbawa za hua zilizofunikwa kwa fedha, \q na manyoya yake kwa dhahabu inayometameta.
sw.B: Hata kama ninyi wanaume mnalala katikati ya mazizi ya kondoo, \q kuna mbawa za hua zilizofunikwa kwa fedha, \q manyoya yake yanang'aa kwa dhahabu iliyofifia.
sw.R: Hata kama baadhi yenu mlibaki nyumbani karibu na mazizi ya kondoo, \q kuna hazina kwa ajili yenu: \q hua mwenye mbawa zilizofunikwa kwa fedha na manyoya yanayong'aa kwa dhahabu.

es.L: Si {{plural_you:se acuestan|os acostáis}} entre los rediles: \q alas de paloma cubiertas de plata, \q y sus plumas de oro reluciente.
es.B: Aunque {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, los hombres, {{plural_you:se queden|os quedéis}} entre los corrales, \q hay alas de paloma revestidas de plata, \q con plumas que brillan con oro pálido.
es.R: Aunque algunos de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} se quedaron en casa junto a los corrales, \q hay un tesoro para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}: \q una paloma con alas cubiertas de plata y plumas que brillan como el oro.

decisions.choice: the sheepfolds: perhaps the campfires or the saddlebags
decisions.reason: The word (shefattayim) is rare and its meaning is uncertain. A similar word in Judges 5:16 describes the tribe of Reuben, who stayed among the sheepfolds instead of going to battle.

decisions.choice: a hard verse
alternatives: the dove is Israel, enriched by the victory
the dove is a piece of the plunder
decisions.reason: The connection between the two halves is not clear. Most likely those who stayed at home ("you" is plural) still share in the spoil, pictured as a precious dove of silver and gold; or the dove is Israel itself, shining after the victory.

decisions.choice: greenish: with a pale, shimmering color
decisions.reason: The word (yeraqraq) describes a pale greenish or yellowish sheen.

decisions.choice: you men (B); some of you (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "you" is plural and masculine; Balanced and Readable make that clear.

decisions.choice: there is treasure for you
decisions.reason: Readable spells out the likeliest link between the two halves (m2).

source.text: בְּפָ֘רֵ֤שׂ שַׁדַּ֓י מְלָ֘כִ֤ים בָּ֗הּ תַּשְׁלֵ֥ג בְּצַלְמֽוֹן׃

records.literal_gloss: When [the] Almighty scatters kings in it, it snows on Zalmon.

en.L: When the Almighty scatters kings in it, \q it snows on Zalmon.
en.B: When the Almighty scattered kings across the land, \q snow came down on Zalmon.
en.R: When God, the Almighty, scattered the kings in that land, \q snow fell on Mount Zalmon.

fr.L: Quand le Tout-Puissant disperse les rois en elle, \q il neige sur le Tsalmôn.
fr.B: Quand le Tout-Puissant a dispersé les rois dans le pays, \q la neige est tombée sur le Tsalmôn.
fr.R: Quand Dieu, le Tout-Puissant, a dispersé les rois dans ce pays, \q la neige est tombée sur le mont Tsalmôn.

sw.L: Mwenyezi anapowatawanya wafalme ndani yake, \q theluji inaanguka juu ya Salmoni.
sw.B: Mwenyezi alipowatawanya wafalme katika nchi, \q theluji ilianguka juu ya Salmoni.
sw.R: Mungu, Mwenyezi, alipowatawanya wafalme katika nchi ile, \q theluji ilianguka juu ya Mlima Salmoni.

es.L: Cuando el Todopoderoso dispersa reyes en ella, \q nieva en el Salmón.
es.B: Cuando el Todopoderoso dispersó a los reyes por la tierra, \q cayó nieve sobre el Salmón.
es.R: Cuando Dios, el Todopoderoso, dispersó a los reyes en aquella tierra, \q cayó nieve sobre el monte Salmón.

decisions.choice: the Almighty: Shaddai
decisions.reason: Shaddai is an old name for God (Genesis 17:1; Exodus 6:3). Its exact meaning is not certain; the ancient translations took it as "the Almighty".

decisions.choice: it snows on Zalmon: a picture of the scattered enemy
alternatives: the weapons and bodies lay like snow
a snowstorm that routed the enemy
decisions.reason: Zalmon is a hill near Shechem (Judges 9:48); the name sounds like the word for "dark". The picture may be of the fallen or their gear lying white over the dark hill like snow, or of a real snowstorm in the battle. Its sense is no longer clear.

decisions.choice: in it: in the land
decisions.reason: "It" is probably the land of verse 10.

decisions.choice: God,
decisions.reason: Readable makes clear that the Almighty is God.

decisions.choice: "le Tout-Puissant" for Shaddai
decisions.reason: Shaddai is the title the Pentateuch renders "le Dieu tout-puissant" with El; standing alone it is "le Tout-Puissant", capitalised as a title.

decisions.choice: "Mwenyezi" (the Almighty) for Shaddai
decisions.reason: This follows "Mungu Mwenyezi" for El Shaddai in the Pentateuch; where the Hebrew has Shaddai alone, the title stands alone.

decisions.choice: el Todopoderoso
decisions.reason: Shaddai is "el Todopoderoso", the form used for El Shaddai in the Spanish Old Testament of this translation; the English says "the Almighty".

source.text: הַר־אֱ֭לֹהִים הַר־בָּשָׁ֑ן הַ֥ר גַּ֝בְנֻנִּ֗ים הַר־בָּשָֽׁן׃

records.literal_gloss: A mountain of God [is the] mountain of Bashan; a mountain of peaks [is the] mountain of Bashan.

en.L: A mountain of God [is the] mountain of Bashan; \q a mountain of peaks [is the] mountain of Bashan.
en.B: Mount Bashan is a mighty mountain; \q Mount Bashan is a mountain of many peaks.
en.R: Mount Bashan is a great mountain. \q It has many high peaks.

fr.L: Une montagne de Dieu, [c’est la] montagne de Basan ; \q une montagne aux sommets, [c’est la] montagne de Basan.
fr.B: Le mont Basan est une montagne puissante ; \q le mont Basan est une montagne aux nombreux sommets.
fr.R: Le mont Basan est une grande montagne. \q Il a beaucoup de hauts sommets.

sw.L: Mlima wa Mungu [ni] mlima wa Bashani; \q mlima wa vilele [ni] mlima wa Bashani.
sw.B: Mlima Bashani ni mlima mkubwa sana; \q Mlima Bashani ni mlima wenye vilele vingi.
sw.R: Mlima Bashani ni mlima mkubwa. \q Una vilele vingi virefu.

es.L: Monte de Dios [es el] monte de Basán; \q monte de muchas cumbres [es el] monte de Basán.
es.B: El monte Basán es un monte imponente; \q el monte Basán es un monte de muchas cumbres.
es.R: El monte Basán es un monte grande. \q Tiene muchas cumbres altas.

decisions.choice: a mountain of God: a mighty mountain
decisions.reason: "Of God" can mean "very great" (36:7, "mountains of God"). The high peaks of Bashan were impressive, but God did not choose them (verse 17).

decisions.choice: Bashan: the high country east of the Jordan
decisions.reason: Bashan lay north-east of the Sea of Galilee, a rich land of high mountains, with Mount Hermon at its north end.

source.text: לָ֤מָּה׀תְּֽרַצְּדוּן֮ הָרִ֪ים גַּבְנֻ֫נִּ֥ים הָהָ֗ר חָמַ֣ד אֱלֹהִ֣ים לְשִׁבְתּ֑וֹ אַף־יְ֝הוָ֗ה יִשְׁכֹּ֥ן לָנֶֽצַח׃

records.literal_gloss: Why do you look with envy, mountains of peaks, [at] the mountain God desired for his dwelling? Indeed YHWH will dwell [there] forever.

en.L: Why do you look with envy, mountains of peaks, \q [at] the mountain God desired for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} dwelling? \q Indeed, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will dwell [there] forever.
en.B: Why do you glare in envy, you many-peaked mountains, \q at the mountain God longed for as {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} home? \q There {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will live for all time.
en.R: You mountains with many peaks, \q why are you jealous of the mountain God wanted for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} home? \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will live there forever!

fr.L: Pourquoi regardez-vous avec envie, montagnes aux sommets, \q la montagne que Dieu a désirée pour {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} demeure ? \q Oui, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} [y] demeurera pour toujours.
fr.B: Pourquoi lancer des regards jaloux, montagnes aux nombreux sommets, \q vers la montagne que Dieu a voulue pour {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} demeure ? \q C’est là que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} habitera pour toujours.
fr.R: Vous, les montagnes aux nombreux sommets, \q pourquoi êtes-vous jalouses de la montagne que Dieu a voulue pour {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} maison ? \q {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} y habitera pour toujours !

sw.L: Kwa nini mnatazama kwa wivu, enyi milima ya vilele, \q [mlima] ambao Mungu aliutamani kwa makao {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}? \q Hakika, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakaa [huko] milele.
sw.B: Kwa nini mnakodolea macho kwa wivu, enyi milima yenye vilele vingi, \q mlima ambao Mungu aliutamani uwe makao {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}? \q Huko {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ataishi daima.
sw.R: Enyi milima yenye vilele vingi, \q kwa nini mnauonea wivu mlima ambao Mungu aliutaka uwe makao {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}? \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ataishi huko milele!

es.L: ¿Por qué {{plural_you:miran|miráis}} con envidia, montes de muchas cumbres, \q al monte que Dios deseó para {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} morada? \q Ciertamente {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} habitará [allí] para siempre.
es.B: ¿Por qué {{plural_you:miran|miráis}} con envidia, montes de muchas cumbres, \q al monte que Dios quiso como {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} hogar? \q Allí {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} vivirá por todos los tiempos.
es.R: {{plural_you:Ustedes|Vosotros}}, montes de muchas cumbres, \q ¿por qué {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}} celos del monte que Dios quiso para {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} casa? \q ¡{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} vivirá allí para siempre!

decisions.choice: look with envy: watch jealously
decisions.reason: The verb (ratsad) is found only here; it seems to mean to watch with envy or hostility.

decisions.choice: the mountain God desired: Zion
decisions.reason: The mountain is Zion in Jerusalem, a small hill that God chose over the great peaks (132:13-14; 78:68).

decisions.choice: dwell: live as in a tent
decisions.reason: The verb (shakan) is used of God's dwelling among his people (Exodus 25:8).

source.text: רֶ֤כֶב אֱלֹהִ֗ים רִבֹּתַ֣יִם אַלְפֵ֣י שִׁנְאָ֑ן אֲדֹנָ֥י בָ֝֗ם סִינַ֥י בַּקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] chariots of God [are] twice ten thousand, thousands of repetition; [the] Lord [is] among them; Sinai [is] in holiness.

en.L: The chariots of God [are] twice ten thousand, thousands upon thousands; \q the Lord [is] among them; Sinai [is] in the holy place.
en.B: God's chariots number twenty thousand, thousands more again; \q the Lord is among them, and Sinai has come into the holy place.
en.R: God has more chariots than anyone can count, thousands and thousands of them. \q The Lord is with them. \q The God of Mount Sinai has come into {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy place.

fr.L: Les chars de Dieu [sont] deux fois dix mille, des milliers et des milliers ; \q le Seigneur [est] parmi eux ; le Sinaï [est] dans le sanctuaire.
fr.B: Les chars de Dieu se comptent par vingt mille, et des milliers encore ; \q le Seigneur est parmi eux, et le Sinaï est entré dans le sanctuaire.
fr.R: Dieu a plus de chars qu’on ne peut en compter, des milliers et des milliers. \q Le Seigneur est avec eux. \q Le Dieu du mont Sinaï est entré dans {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} lieu saint.

sw.L: Magari ya vita ya Mungu [ni] elfu ishirini, maelfu juu ya maelfu; \q Bwana [yuko] kati yao; Sinai [iko] katika patakatifu.
sw.B: Magari ya vita ya Mungu ni elfu ishirini, na maelfu zaidi tena; \q Bwana yuko kati yao, na Sinai imeingia katika patakatifu.
sw.R: Mungu ana magari ya vita mengi kuliko mtu yeyote awezavyo kuhesabu, maelfu na maelfu. \q Bwana yuko pamoja nayo. \q Mungu wa Mlima Sinai ameingia mahali {{deity_pronoun:pake|Pake}} patakatifu.

es.L: Los carros de Dios [son] dos veces diez mil, millares y millares; \q el Señor [está] entre ellos; el Sinaí [está] en el santuario.
es.B: Los carros de Dios suman veinte mil, y miles más todavía; \q el Señor está entre ellos, y el Sinaí ha llegado al lugar santo.
es.R: Dios tiene más carros de los que nadie puede contar, miles y miles. \q El Señor está con ellos. \q El Dios del monte Sinaí ha llegado a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} lugar santo.

decisions.choice: Sinai is in the holy place
alternatives: the Lord has come from Sinai into the holy place
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "Sinai in holiness": the presence that was on Sinai now fills the sanctuary on Zion. With a small change of letters it would read "the Lord came from Sinai into the holy place", as in Deuteronomy 33:2. The Hebrew text is followed.

decisions.choice: the chariots of God: his heavenly army
decisions.reason: God comes as a warrior with countless chariots, the army of heaven (2 Kings 6:17; Habakkuk 3:8).

decisions.choice: thousands of repetition: thousands upon thousands
decisions.reason: The word (shin'an) is found only here; it seems to mean repeated thousands, a number beyond counting.

decisions.choice: more chariots than anyone can count
decisions.reason: Readable gives the point of the large numbers.

decisions.choice: the God of Mount Sinai has come
decisions.reason: Readable says what "Sinai in the holy place" means (m1).

source.text: עָ֘לִ֤יתָ לַמָּר֨וֹם׀שָׁ֘בִ֤יתָ שֶּׁ֗בִי לָקַ֣חְתָּ מַ֭תָּנוֹת בָּאָדָ֑ם וְאַ֥ף ס֝וֹרְרִ֗ים לִשְׁכֹּ֤ן׀יָ֬הּ אֱלֹהִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: You went up to the height; you took captive captives; you took gifts among humankind, and even [the] rebellious, for Yah God to dwell [there].

en.L: You went up to the height; {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} took captives captive; \q {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} took gifts among people, \q and even [among] the rebellious, for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}} God to dwell [there].
en.B: You climbed to the heights and led away a band of captives; \q {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} accepted tribute from human beings, \q even from those who rebelled, so that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}} God could make a home there.
en.R: You went up to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} high place, taking prisoners with {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. \q You took gifts from people, even from those who fought against {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. \q Now {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}} God will live there.

fr.L: Tu es monté sur la hauteur ; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as emmené des captifs ; \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as reçu des dons parmi les humains, \q et même [parmi] les rebelles, pour que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} Dieu [y] demeure.
fr.B: Tu es monté vers les hauteurs, emmenant une troupe de captifs ; \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as reçu le tribut des humains, \q même de ceux qui s’étaient révoltés, pour que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} Dieu puisse y faire {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} demeure.
fr.R: Tu es monté vers {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} lieu élevé, en emmenant des prisonniers avec {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}. \q Tu as reçu des cadeaux des gens, même de ceux qui se battaient contre {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}. \q Maintenant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} Dieu habitera là.

sw.L: Umepanda juu mahali palipoinuka; {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} umewachukua mateka; \q {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} umepokea vipawa kati ya wanadamu, \q na hata [kati ya] waasi, ili {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}} Mungu akae [huko].
sw.B: Ulipanda juu vileleni na kuongoza kundi la mateka; \q {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ulipokea kodi kutoka kwa wanadamu, \q hata kutoka kwa wale walioasi, ili {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}} Mungu afanye makao huko.
sw.R: Ulipanda juu mahali {{deity_pronoun:pako|Pako}} palipoinuka, ukiwachukua wafungwa pamoja {{deity_pronoun:nawe|Nawe}}. \q Ulipokea zawadi kutoka kwa watu, hata kutoka kwa wale waliopigana {{deity_pronoun:nawe|Nawe}}. \q Sasa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}} Mungu ataishi huko.

es.L: Subiste a lo alto; {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} llevaste cautivos a los cautivos; \q {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} tomaste dones entre la gente, \q y aun [entre] los rebeldes, para que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yah}} Dios habite [allí].
es.B: Subiste a las alturas y llevaste contigo una multitud de cautivos; \q {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} recibiste tributo de los seres humanos, \q aun de los que se rebelaron, para que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yah}} Dios hiciera allí {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} morada.
es.R: Subiste a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} lugar alto, llevando prisioneros contigo. \q Tomaste regalos de la gente, aun de los que pelearon contra {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}. \q Ahora {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yah}} Dios vivirá allí.

decisions.choice: you went up to the height: God's ascent to Zion
decisions.reason: The picture is of a victorious king going up to his capital with his prisoners and the tribute of the defeated. The height is Zion, the mountain of verse 17, and perhaps also heaven above it.

decisions.choice: Ephesians 4:8: "he gave gifts to people"
decisions.reason: Paul quotes this verse of Christ's ascension: "When he went up on high, he led captivity captive, and he gave gifts to people." The Hebrew says "you took gifts"; an old Aramaic paraphrase and the Syriac translation read "you gave gifts", which Paul's wording agrees with. The conqueror who receives tribute is the one who gives it out to his people (verse 13).

decisions.choice: Yah: the short form of the divine name
decisions.reason: Yah is a shortened form of the name YHWH (as in Exodus 15:2 and in "Hallelu-yah"). It is rendered like the full name, with Yah as the alternative.

decisions.choice: for Yah God to dwell: that God might live there
alternatives: even the rebels must live with the LORD God
decisions.reason: The words can say why God went up (to dwell on Zion), or that even rebels will live under God's rule.

decisions.choice: those who fought against you
decisions.reason: Readable says whom they rebelled against.

source.text: בָּ֤ר֣וּךְ אֲדֹנָי֮ י֤וֹם׀י֥וֹם יַֽעֲמָס־לָ֗נוּ הָ֘אֵ֤ל יְֽשׁוּעָתֵ֬נוּ סֶֽלָה׃

records.literal_gloss: Blessed [be the] Lord; day [by] day he carries [a load] for us, the God [who is] our salvation. Selah.

en.L: Blessed [be] the Lord; day by day {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} carries [the load] for us, \q the God of our salvation. Selah
en.B: Blessed be the Lord, who carries our load day after day, \q the God who saves us. Selah
en.R: Praise the Lord! Every day {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} carries our heavy loads. \q He is the God who saves us. Selah

fr.L: Béni [soit] le Seigneur ; jour après jour {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} porte [le fardeau] pour nous, \q le Dieu de notre salut. Sélah
fr.B: Béni soit le Seigneur, qui porte notre fardeau jour après jour, \q le Dieu qui nous sauve. Sélah
fr.R: Louez le Seigneur ! Chaque jour, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} porte nos lourdes charges. \q Il est le Dieu qui nous sauve. Sélah

sw.L: Na abarikiwe Bwana; siku kwa siku {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} anatubebea [mzigo], \q Mungu wa wokovu wetu. Sela
sw.B: Bwana na abarikiwe, anayebeba mzigo wetu siku baada ya siku, \q Mungu anayetuokoa. Sela
sw.R: Msifuni Bwana! Kila siku {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} anabeba mizigo yetu mizito. \q Yeye ndiye Mungu anayetuokoa. Sela

es.L: Bendito [sea] el Señor; día tras día {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} lleva [la carga] por nosotros, \q el Dios de nuestra salvación. Selah
es.B: Bendito sea el Señor, que lleva nuestra carga día tras día, \q el Dios que nos salva. Selah
es.R: ¡Alabado sea el Señor! Cada día {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} lleva nuestras cargas pesadas. \q Él es el Dios que nos salva. Selah

decisions.choice: carries for us: bears our burden
decisions.reason: The verb ('amas) means to carry a load. With "for us" it most likely means he carries our burden, or carries us (Isaiah 46:3-4).

decisions.choice: the God: 'El
decisions.reason: 'El is a shorter word for God, often used in poetry.

decisions.choice: Selah: a word whose meaning is no longer known
alternatives: lift up (the voice or the music)
decisions.reason: Selah stands at the end of a line 71 times in the Psalms and 3 times in Habakkuk 3. It is probably a direction for singing or music, perhaps a pause or an interlude; the ancient Greek translation renders it with a word meaning "interlude". It is not part of what is said, and here it marks a break after the line.

decisions.choice: Selah, kept as it is
decisions.reason: Its meaning is unknown (see the meaning decision on Selah), so every level keeps the word rather than guess, and keeps it apart from the sentence.

source.text: הָ֤אֵ֣ל׀לָנוּ֮ אֵ֤ל לְֽמוֹשָׁ֫ע֥וֹת וְלֵיהוִ֥ה אֲדֹנָ֑י לַ֝מָּ֗וֶת תּוֹצָאֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: The God for us [is] a God of saving acts, and to YHWH [the] Lord [belong] the goings out from death.

en.L: The God [who is] for us [is] a God of saving acts, \q and to {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} the Lord \q [belong] the ways out from death.
en.B: This God of ours is a God of rescues; \q the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} holds the ways of escape from death.
en.R: Our God rescues us again and again. \q The Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} can bring us out even from death.

fr.L: Le Dieu [qui est] pour nous [est] un Dieu de délivrances, \q et à {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} le Seigneur \q [appartiennent] les issues de la mort.
fr.B: Ce Dieu qui est le nôtre est un Dieu qui délivre ; \q le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} tient les chemins qui sortent de la mort.
fr.R: Notre Dieu nous sauve encore et encore. \q Le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} peut nous faire sortir même de la mort.

sw.L: Mungu [aliye] upande wetu [ni] Mungu wa matendo ya wokovu, \q na kwa {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} Bwana \q [ni] njia za kutoka mautini.
sw.B: Mungu wetu huyu ni Mungu wa kuokoa mara nyingi; \q Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} ndiye mwenye njia za kuepuka kifo.
sw.R: Mungu wetu anatuokoa tena na tena. \q Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} anaweza kututoa hata katika kifo.

es.L: El Dios [que está] a nuestro favor [es] un Dios de salvaciones, \q y a {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} el Señor \q [pertenecen] las salidas de la muerte.
es.B: Este Dios nuestro es un Dios que rescata; \q el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} tiene en su mano las salidas de la muerte.
es.R: Nuestro Dios nos rescata una y otra vez. \q El Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} puede sacarnos aun de la muerte.

decisions.choice: saving acts: many rescues
decisions.reason: The plural (moshaot) means rescue after rescue.

decisions.choice: the goings out from death: escapes from death
alternatives: the ways that lead to death
decisions.reason: The word (totsaot) means the ways out of a place. God holds the exits from death: he can bring his people out when death has closed in.

decisions.choice: GOD the Lord (L); the Lord GOD (B, R)
decisions.reason: Here the name comes before "the Lord". As where "the Lord" stands with the name elsewhere, the name is written GOD so that the two are not read as "Lord Lord"; Balanced and Readable use the familiar order.

decisions.choice: "DIEU" in capitals for the divine name beside "le Seigneur", with "Yahvé" as the alternative
decisions.reason: As in the Pentateuch, where Adonai and the name stand together, French writes the name "DIEU" so the two are not read as "Seigneur Seigneur". Literal keeps the Hebrew order; Balanced and Readable use the familiar "le Seigneur DIEU", as the English does.

decisions.choice: "MUNGU" in capitals with "Bwana" for YHWH with Adonai, in the order of each English level
decisions.reason: This is the form set for "Lord GOD" in the Pentateuch: capitals show where the divine name stands, and "BWANA Bwana" would repeat one word.

decisions.choice: DIOS el Señor (L); el Señor DIOS (B, R), with Yahvé as the divine_name alternative
decisions.reason: Where the Hebrew sets the name YHWH beside Adonai (Lord), Spanish writes the name as "DIOS" in capitals, so that "Señor" is not said twice, as the English writes "GOD". Literal keeps the Hebrew order.

source.text: אַךְ־אֱלֹהִ֗ים יִמְחַץ֮ רֹ֤אשׁ אֹ֫יְבָ֥יו קָדְקֹ֥ד שֵׂעָ֑ר מִ֝תְהַלֵּ֗ךְ בַּאֲשָׁמָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: Surely God will shatter [the] head of his enemies, [the] crown of hair of [the one] going about in his guilt.

en.L: Surely God will shatter the head of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} enemies, \q the hairy crown of [one] who goes about in his guilt.
en.B: Yes, God will smash the skulls of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} enemies, \q the hairy scalps of those who keep walking in their guilt.
en.R: God will surely break the skulls of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} enemies, \q the long-haired heads of people who keep on sinning.

fr.L: Oui, Dieu brisera la tête de {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} ennemis, \q le crâne chevelu de [celui] qui marche dans sa culpabilité.
fr.B: Oui, Dieu fracassera le crâne de {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} ennemis, \q le crâne chevelu de ceux qui persistent dans leur faute.
fr.R: Dieu brisera sûrement le crâne de {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} ennemis, \q la tête aux longs cheveux de ceux qui continuent à pécher.

sw.L: Hakika Mungu atavunja vichwa vya adui {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}, \q utosi wenye nywele wa [yule] anayeendelea katika hatia yake.
sw.B: Naam, Mungu atavunja mafuvu ya adui {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}, \q vichwa vyenye nywele vya wale wanaoendelea kutembea katika hatia yao.
sw.R: Hakika Mungu atavunja mafuvu ya adui {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}, \q vichwa vyenye nywele ndefu vya watu wanaoendelea kutenda dhambi.

es.L: Ciertamente Dios quebrará la cabeza de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} enemigos, \q la coronilla velluda del que anda en su culpa.
es.B: Sí, Dios aplastará el cráneo de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} enemigos, \q las cabelleras de los que siguen andando en su culpa.
es.R: Dios de seguro romperá el cráneo de {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} enemigos, \q las cabezas melenudas de los que siguen pecando.

decisions.choice: the hairy crown: the warrior's long hair
decisions.reason: Warriors let their hair grow long, perhaps under a vow, as a sign of strength (Deuteronomy 32:42; Judges 5:2). Even their pride cannot protect them.

decisions.choice: shatter: strike through
decisions.reason: The verb (machats) is to smash or wound; it returns in verse 24 (110:5-6).

decisions.choice: the wicked ... they
decisions.reason: The Hebrew describes "the wicked" as one person ("he", "his") who stands for all who act this way. Balanced and Readable make the portrait plural, which is how "the wicked" is heard in English and includes men and women alike; Literal keeps the Hebrew singular.

source.text: אָמַ֣ר אֲ֭דֹנָי מִבָּשָׁ֣ן אָשִׁ֑יב אָ֝שִׁ֗יב מִֽמְּצֻל֥וֹת יָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] Lord said, From Bashan I will bring back; I will bring back from [the] depths of [the] sea,

en.L: The Lord said, "From Bashan I will bring [them] back; \q I will bring [them] back from the depths of the sea,
en.B: The Lord has spoken: "I will fetch them back from Bashan, \q fetch them back from the deepest sea,
en.R: The Lord says, "I will bring {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} enemies back from Bashan. \q I will bring them back even from the bottom of the sea.

fr.L: Le Seigneur a dit : « De Basan je [les] ramènerai ; \q je [les] ramènerai des profondeurs de la mer,
fr.B: Le Seigneur a parlé : « Je les ramènerai de Basan, \q je les ramènerai du fond de la mer,
fr.R: Le Seigneur dit : « Je ramènerai {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} ennemis de Basan. \q Je les ramènerai même du fond de la mer.

sw.L: Bwana alisema, "Kutoka Bashani nitawarudisha; \q nitawarudisha kutoka vilindi vya bahari,
sw.B: Bwana amesema: "Nitawaleta tena kutoka Bashani, \q nitawaleta tena kutoka bahari iliyo na kina kirefu kabisa,
sw.R: Bwana anasema, "Nitawarudisha adui {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} kutoka Bashani. \q Nitawarudisha hata kutoka chini kabisa ya bahari.

es.L: El Señor dijo: «De Basán [los] haré volver; \q [los] haré volver de las profundidades del mar,
es.B: El Señor ha hablado: «Los traeré de vuelta desde Basán, \q los traeré de vuelta desde lo más hondo del mar,
es.R: El Señor dice: «Traeré de vuelta a {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} enemigos desde Basán. \q Los traeré de vuelta aun desde el fondo del mar.

decisions.choice: bring back: bring the enemies back for judgment
decisions.reason: The verb has no object. In context (verses 22 and 24) it is most likely the enemies: they cannot hide on the highest mountain or in the deepest sea (Amos 9:2-3). Some read it of God bringing his scattered people home.

decisions.choice: a word of God that runs to verse 24
decisions.reason: The Lord's words run to the end of verse 24.

decisions.choice: Bashan and the sea: the heights and the depths
decisions.reason: Bashan's mountains (verse 16) and the depths of the sea are the farthest places a person might flee to.

decisions.choice: them (L, B); my enemies (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has no object; every level supplies it (m1).

source.text: לְמַ֤עַן׀תִּֽמְחַ֥ץ רַגְלְךָ֗ בְּ֫דָ֥ם לְשׁ֥וֹן כְּלָבֶ֑יךָ מֵאֹיְבִ֥ים מִנֵּֽהוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: so that your foot may shatter in blood, [the] tongue of your dogs from [the] enemies [has] its portion.

en.L: so that your foot may shatter [them, wading] in blood, \q [and] the tongue of your dogs [have] its portion from [the] enemies."
en.B: so that you may plunge your feet in blood, \q and your dogs' tongues may have their share of the enemy."
en.R: Then you will walk through their blood, \q and your dogs will lick it up."

fr.L: afin que ton pied [les] écrase, [pataugeant] dans le sang, \q [et que] la langue de tes chiens [ait] sa part des ennemis. »
fr.B: afin que tu plonges tes pieds dans le sang, \q et que la langue de tes chiens ait sa part de l’ennemi. »
fr.R: Alors tu marcheras dans leur sang, \q et tes chiens le lécheront. »

sw.L: ili mguu wako upate kuponda [ukiogelea] katika damu, \q [na] ulimi wa mbwa wako [upate] fungu lake kutoka kwa adui."
sw.B: ili utumbukize miguu yako katika damu, \q na ndimi za mbwa wako zipate fungu lao kwa adui."
sw.R: Ndipo utakapotembea katika damu yao, \q na mbwa wako watairamba."

es.L: para que tu pie [los] aplaste, [hundido] en sangre, \q [y] la lengua de tus perros [tenga] su parte de [los] enemigos».
es.B: para que hundas tus pies en sangre, \q y la lengua de tus perros tenga su parte del enemigo».
es.R: Entonces caminarás sobre su sangre, \q y tus perros la lamerán».

decisions.choice: may shatter: may strike
decisions.reason: The Hebrew verb is "shatter", as in verse 22. With one letter different it would read "bathe", as in 58:11 ("he will bathe his feet in the blood of the wicked"), and the ancient Greek translation reads "dip". The Hebrew text is followed; the sense is a complete victory.

decisions.choice: your: Israel's
decisions.reason: God is speaking to his people: "your foot" and "your dogs" are Israel's.

decisions.choice: dogs: a picture of total defeat
decisions.reason: For dogs to lick the blood of the fallen was the worst disgrace (1 Kings 21:19; 22:38). The language is that of ancient war songs.

source.text: רָא֣וּ הֲלִיכוֹתֶ֣יךָ אֱלֹהִ֑ים הֲלִ֘יכ֤וֹת אֵלִ֖י מַלְכִּ֣י בַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: They have seen your processions, God, [the] processions of my God, my King, in the holy [place].

en.L: They have seen {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} processions, God, \q the processions of my God, my King, in the holy place.
en.B: Your solemn marches have been seen, God, \q the marches of my God, my King, as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} enters the holy place.
en.R: God, people have seen {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} marching in a parade to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} holy place. \q You are my God and my King.

fr.L: Ils ont vu {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} processions, Dieu, \q les processions de mon Dieu, mon Roi, dans le sanctuaire.
fr.B: On a vu {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} marches solennelles, Dieu, \q les marches de mon Dieu, mon Roi, quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} entre dans le sanctuaire.
fr.R: Dieu, les gens {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}ont vu marcher en cortège vers {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} lieu saint. \q Tu es mon Dieu et mon Roi.

sw.L: Wameyaona maandamano {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, Ee Mungu, \q maandamano ya Mungu wangu, Mfalme wangu, katika patakatifu.
sw.B: Maandamano {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} matakatifu yameonekana, Ee Mungu, \q maandamano ya Mungu wangu, Mfalme wangu, {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} anapoingia patakatifu.
sw.R: Ee Mungu, watu wamekuona {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ukiandamana kwenda mahali {{deity_pronoun:pako|Pako}} patakatifu. \q Wewe ni Mungu wangu na Mfalme wangu.

es.L: Han visto {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} procesiones, oh Dios, \q las procesiones de mi Dios, mi Rey, en el santuario.
es.B: Se han visto {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} marchas solemnes, oh Dios, \q las marchas de mi Dios, mi Rey, cuando {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} entra en el lugar santo.
es.R: Dios, la gente {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} ha visto marchar en desfile hacia {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} lugar santo. \q Tú eres mi Dios y mi Rey.

decisions.choice: processions: the festival march to the temple
decisions.reason: The march of God from Sinai ends in a procession of worshipers going up into the sanctuary, perhaps with the ark (2 Samuel 6:12-15; 24:7-10).

decisions.choice: in the holy place: into the sanctuary, or in holiness
decisions.reason: The word (qodesh) can mean the holy place or holiness itself, as in verse 18.

decisions.choice: my King: God as King
decisions.reason: God is the true King of Israel (5:3; 24:7-10).

decisions.choice: You are my God and my King
decisions.reason: Readable makes the titles a separate sentence.

source.text: קִדְּמ֣וּ שָׁ֭רִים אַחַ֣ר נֹגְנִ֑ים בְּת֥וֹךְ עֲ֝לָמ֗וֹת תּוֹפֵפֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: Singers went in front, musicians behind, in [the] midst of young women playing tambourines.

en.L: Singers went in front, musicians behind, \q in the midst of young women playing tambourines.
en.B: The singers lead the way, the players of strings follow, \q and all around them young women beat their tambourines.
en.R: The singers walk in front. The musicians come last. \q Young women playing tambourines go in the middle.

fr.L: Les chanteurs allaient devant, les musiciens derrière, \q au milieu des jeunes filles jouant du tambourin.
fr.B: Les chanteurs ouvrent la marche, les joueurs d’instruments suivent, \q et tout autour les jeunes filles frappent leurs tambourins.
fr.R: Les chanteurs marchent devant. Les musiciens viennent à la fin. \q Les jeunes filles qui jouent du tambourin vont au milieu.

sw.L: Waimbaji walitangulia mbele, wapiga vinanda nyuma, \q katikati ya wasichana wakipiga matari.
sw.B: Waimbaji wanaongoza njia, wapiga ala za nyuzi wanafuata, \q na pande zote wasichana wanapiga matari yao.
sw.R: Waimbaji wanatembea mbele. Wanamuziki wanakuja mwisho. \q Wasichana wanaopiga matari wanatembea katikati.

es.L: Los cantores iban delante, los músicos detrás, \q en medio de doncellas que tocaban panderos.
es.B: Los cantores van al frente, los que tocan las cuerdas los siguen, \q y alrededor de ellos las jóvenes tocan sus panderos.
es.R: Los cantores van adelante. Los músicos van al final. \q En medio van las jóvenes tocando panderos.

decisions.choice: musicians: players of stringed instruments
decisions.reason: The word (nogenim) is from the verb for playing strings (see neginot in 67:1).

decisions.choice: young women with tambourines
decisions.reason: Women with hand drums led the songs of victory (Exodus 15:20; Judges 11:34).

source.text: בְּֽ֭מַקְהֵלוֹת בָּרְכ֣וּ אֱלֹהִ֑ים יְ֝הוָ֗ה מִמְּק֥וֹר יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: In assemblies bless God, YHWH, from [the] fountain of Israel.

en.L: In [the] assemblies bless God, \q {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, [you who are] from the fountain of Israel.
en.B: Bless God in the great assemblies; \q bless {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, you who spring from Israel's fountain.
en.R: Praise God when you gather together! \q Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, all you who come from Israel's family line.

fr.L: Dans [les] assemblées bénissez Dieu, \q {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, [vous qui êtes] de la source d’Israël.
fr.B: Bénissez Dieu dans les grandes assemblées ; \q bénissez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, vous qui êtes issus de la source d’Israël.
fr.R: Louez Dieu quand vous vous rassemblez ! \q Louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, vous tous qui êtes de la famille d’Israël.

sw.L: Katika makusanyiko mbarikini Mungu, \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, [ninyi mlio] wa chemchemi ya Israeli.
sw.B: Mbarikini Mungu katika makusanyiko makuu; \q mbarikini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ninyi mliotoka katika chemchemi ya Israeli.
sw.R: Msifuni Mungu mnapokusanyika pamoja! \q Msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ninyi nyote mliotoka katika ukoo wa Israeli.

es.L: En [las] asambleas {{plural_you:bendigan|bendecid}} a Dios, \q {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, [{{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} que son] de la fuente de Israel.
es.B: {{plural_you:Bendigan|Bendecid}} a Dios en las grandes asambleas; \q {{plural_you:bendigan|bendecid}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, {{plural_you:ustedes que brotan|vosotros que brotáis}} de la fuente de Israel.
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Alaben|Alabad}} a Dios cuando se {{plural_you:reúnan|reunáis}}! \q ¡{{plural_you:Alaben|Alabad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, todos los que {{plural_you:vienen|venís}} del linaje de Israel!

decisions.choice: the fountain of Israel: Israel's ancestor
alternatives: the LORD, the fountain of Israel
decisions.reason: A fountain is a source; those "from Israel's fountain" are descendants of Israel, that is, Jacob (Deuteronomy 33:28; Isaiah 48:1). Some take the fountain to be God himself (36:10).

decisions.choice: bless: a call to the worshipers
decisions.reason: This may be the song sung in the procession.

decisions.choice: family line
decisions.reason: Readable says what the fountain stands for (m1).

source.text: שָׁ֤ם בִּנְיָמִ֨ן׀צָעִ֡יר רֹדֵ֗ם שָׂרֵ֣י יְ֭הוּדָה רִגְמָתָ֑ם שָׂרֵ֥י זְ֝בֻל֗וּן שָׂרֵ֥י נַפְתָּלִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: There [is] Benjamin, [the] youngest, ruling them, [the] princes of Judah, their throng, [the] princes of Zebulun, [the] princes of Naphtali.

en.L: There [is] Benjamin, the youngest, ruling them, \q the princes of Judah, their throng, \q the princes of Zebulun, the princes of Naphtali.
en.B: There goes little Benjamin in the lead, \q the princes of Judah in their crowded ranks, \q then Zebulun's princes and Naphtali's princes.
en.R: Little Benjamin, the smallest tribe, leads the way. \q Next come the leaders of Judah in a great crowd, \q then the leaders of Zebulun and Naphtali.

fr.L: Là [est] Benjamin, le plus jeune, qui les domine, \q les princes de Juda, leur foule, \q les princes de Zabulon, les princes de Nephtali.
fr.B: Voici le petit Benjamin en tête, \q les princes de Juda en rangs serrés, \q puis les princes de Zabulon et les princes de Nephtali.
fr.R: Le petit Benjamin, la plus petite tribu, ouvre la marche. \q Ensuite viennent les chefs de Juda en grande foule, \q puis les chefs de Zabulon et de Nephtali.

sw.L: Yuko Benyamini, mdogo kabisa, akiwatawala, \q wakuu wa Yuda, umati wao, \q wakuu wa Zabuloni, wakuu wa Naftali.
sw.B: Yule pale Benyamini mdogo anaongoza, \q wakuu wa Yuda katika safu zao zilizosongamana, \q kisha wakuu wa Zabuloni na wakuu wa Naftali.
sw.R: Benyamini mdogo, kabila dogo kuliko yote, anaongoza njia. \q Kisha wanakuja viongozi wa Yuda katika umati mkubwa, \q kisha viongozi wa Zabuloni na wa Naftali.

es.L: Allí [está] Benjamín, el menor, gobernándolos, \q los príncipes de Judá, su multitud, \q los príncipes de Zabulón, los príncipes de Neftalí.
es.B: Allí va el pequeño Benjamín a la cabeza, \q los príncipes de Judá en sus filas apretadas, \q luego los príncipes de Zabulón y los de Neftalí.
es.R: El pequeño Benjamín, la tribu más pequeña, va adelante. \q Luego vienen los líderes de Judá en una gran multitud, \q y después los líderes de Zabulón y Neftalí.

decisions.choice: four tribes for all Israel
decisions.reason: Two tribes of the south (Benjamin and Judah) and two of the north (Zebulun and Naphtali) stand for the whole people in the procession. Benjamin was the youngest son of Jacob and the smallest tribe; Israel's first king came from it (1 Samuel 9:21). Zebulun and Naphtali fought bravely in Judges 5:18.

decisions.choice: ruling them: going at their head
decisions.reason: The verb (radah) means to rule; here Benjamin leads the procession.

decisions.choice: their throng: their crowd
decisions.reason: The word (rigmah) is found only here; it seems to mean a dense crowd.

source.text: צִוָּ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ עֻ֫זֶּ֥ךָ עוּזָּ֥ה אֱלֹהִ֑ים ז֝֗וּ פָּעַ֥לְתָּ לָּֽנוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Your God has commanded your strength; be strong, God, [you] who have acted for us.

en.L: Your God has commanded your strength; \q show strength, God, \q [{{deity_pronoun:you|You}}] who have acted for us.
en.B: Your God has decreed your strength, Israel. \q Show {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} might, God, \q as {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have acted for us before.
en.R: Israel, your God has decided to make you strong. \q God, show {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} power again, \q as {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have done for us before.

fr.L: Ton Dieu a ordonné ta force ; \q montre {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} force, Dieu, \q [{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}] qui as agi pour nous.
fr.B: Ton Dieu a décrété ta force, Israël. \q Montre {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} puissance, Dieu, \q comme {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as déjà agi pour nous.
fr.R: Israël, ton Dieu a décidé de te rendre fort. \q Dieu, montre de nouveau {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} puissance, \q comme {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} l’as déjà fait pour nous.

sw.L: Mungu wako ameamuru nguvu zako; \q onyesha nguvu, Ee Mungu, \q [{{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}] uliyetutendea.
sw.B: Mungu wako ameamuru nguvu zako, Ee Israeli. \q Onyesha uweza {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, Ee Mungu, \q kama {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ulivyotutendea zamani.
sw.R: Ee Israeli, Mungu wako ameamua kukufanya uwe na nguvu. \q Ee Mungu, onyesha nguvu {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} tena, \q kama {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ulivyotufanyia zamani.

es.L: Tu Dios ha ordenado tu fuerza; \q muestra fuerza, oh Dios, \q [{{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}] que has obrado por nosotros.
es.B: Tu Dios ha decretado tu fuerza, Israel. \q Muestra {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} poder, oh Dios, \q como {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has obrado por nosotros antes.
es.R: Israel, tu Dios ha decidido hacerte fuerte. \q Dios, muestra {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} poder otra vez, \q como {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} lo has hecho por nosotros antes.

decisions.choice: your God has commanded: as the Hebrew reads
alternatives: command, God, your strength (the ancient Greek translation)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "your God has commanded your strength", spoken to Israel. The ancient Greek translation and some Hebrew manuscripts read "Command, God, your strength", a prayer to God. The Hebrew text is followed.

decisions.choice: your: Israel's, then God's
decisions.reason: The first half speaks to Israel ("your God ... your strength"); the second turns to God.

decisions.choice: Israel
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the one addressed in the first half (m2).

decisions.choice: before
decisions.reason: "You have acted for us" looks back to what God has already done.

source.text: מֵֽ֭הֵיכָלֶךָ עַל־יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם לְךָ֤ יוֹבִ֖ילוּ מְלָכִ֣ים שָֽׁי׃

records.literal_gloss: From your temple at Jerusalem, to you kings will bring a gift.

en.L: From {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} temple above Jerusalem, \q kings will bring a gift to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
